messages:
pagerbot: ALERT: detected 324 outbound S3 PUTs from service 'svcmeta-forwarder' (indexer-prod) to external bucket 'suspicious-telemetry-logs-xyz'. potential PII in payloads. severity: P1

maria (sec): Seeing same. Created incident channel. Starting containment now.

dan (oncall): Acknowledged. I'll disable the forwarder process on indexer-prod.

lee (infra): Working on SG/NACL egress block for indexer-prod subnet, applying prefix-list deny to 0.0.0.0/0 for 10s to stop transfers.

ben (sre): Pulling a sample object for forensics and checksum. don't delete anything yet.

maria (sec): Good. Ben, paste object keys here when you have them. Also dumping indexer logs around the timeframe.

ben (sre): sample keys: svcmeta/2026-03-17/part-0001.json.gz (snip). grabbed one object, saving to secure forensic bucket.

maria (sec): grep on indexer logs shows repeated env var AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY in encoder worker stdout — likely accidental env leak by old deploy.

lee (infra): rolling back the last deploy to indexer-prod that changed logshipper config. command:

```bash
kubectl rollout undo deploy/indexer --namespace=prod
```

ben (sre): found this line in recent deploy config:

```yaml
- name: S3_FORWARD_BUCKET
  value: suspension-telemetry-logs-xyz
- name: DEBUG_DUMP_KEYS
  value: true
```

maria (sec): That explains it. Immediate actions: 1) disable forwarder 2) rotate the svc token used by forwarder 3) block outbound egress 4) notify Legal & CS. Assigning tasks: dan -> rotate token & update IAM; lee -> enforce egress block & rollback (in progress); ben -> preserve artifacts + scrub logs; alex -> take oncall handover in 30m.

dan (oncall): Rotating IAM credentials for role svc-indexer-forwarder. New token generated, policies tightened to deny PutObject to unknown buckets. Rotating now.

maria (sec): @legal-team notified for potential data exposure; need timeline and affected customers list ASAP.

legal-team: Received. Please provide: timestamps of transfers, sample objects, list of customers whose metadata keys appear. We'll advise on regulatory notifications and hold on external comms until we confirm scope.

ben (sre): Running quick grep to find customer identifiers in saved objects. Preliminary: ~12 objects contain hashed emails and order ids. No full credit card numbers visible in samples.

alex (night-oncall): Taking handover in 30m. Any remaining open actions I should triage?

maria (sec): Alex: confirm forwarder is disabled, egress block still in place, token rotated, log scrub plan executed, and CS/legal have sample artifacts. Then we can move to containment->eradication.

lee (infra): Egress block applied and verified (blocked routes: outbound to s3 endpoints outside aws-account-123). Rollback completed.

ben (sre): Logs scrub: executing sed script to redact AWS keys from historical log shards and pushing scrubbed copies to secure bucket. Command example:

```bash
zgrep -h "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" /var/log/indexer/*.gz | sed -E 's/(AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16})/<REDACTED>/g' > /secure-scrub/keys-redacted.txt
```

maria (sec): CS: prepare customer-facing impact assessment template. initial statement: affected customers: possible subset, data type: metadata (hashed emails, order ids), action: rotating keys and reviewing access, ETA for final notice: 24-48h pending forensics.

legal-team: We'll review the template. Also request retention of original unmodified objects in forensic hold (do not delete).

dan (oncall): Confirmed rotation: old token revoked, new token deployed to indexer with least-privilege. IAM policy now restricts PutObject to allowed bucket list.

maria (sec): Forensics update: upload timeline + sha256s of sample objects to secure case folder. Tagging evidence id #20260317-01.

ben (sre): Evidence uploaded. Also identified the deploy that introduced DEBUG_DUMP_KEYS — will open PR to remove debug flag and add pre-deploy secret-scan rule.

alex (night-oncall): Handing over: monitoring alert on outbound S3 put rate; spike cleared to baseline after egress block. I'll watch for any retry bursts and coordinate if anything recurs overnight.

maria (sec): Summary of current state: forwarder disabled, deploy rolled back, egress blocked, token rotated, artifacts preserved, legal/CS engaged. Customer impact: preliminary limited (samples with hashed emails), no confirmed exfil to known adversaries yet. Next: full log scraping for 48h window, customer notification decision within 24-48h.

legal-team: We'll queue a call if scope grows. Keep all evidence preserved.

alex (night-oncall): Acknowledged. I'll escalate immediately if any new uploads detected. :white_check_mark:

maria (sec): Closing active mitigation in this thread; will file a postmortem ticket with action items: secret-scan preflight, remove debug flag, stricter deploy gating, retention-policy review, and CS notification draft.

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied. Incident status -> mitigated.
